findings.claim: The review/open branch dispatches the reviewer and advances without writing reviewLog.
findings.intended: For this code finding, open must DISPATCH, WRITE reviewLog, then NEXT.
findings.actual: The open branch emits DISPATCH then NEXT; WRITE is absent.

findings.claim: The broad open row precedes the more specific broken-record row, so overlapping states select open.
findings.intended: The broken-record row is selected and produces ASK.
findings.actual: The open row is selected first and produces DISPATCH then NEXT.

findings.claim: The review table closes without an unconditional default row for an unclassified verdict.
findings.actual: No row matches mystery, causing no-row-error.

findings.claim: reviewLog declares no reader even though review completion depends on persisted reviewLog presence.
findings.intended: The review stage is declared as a reader of reviewLog.
findings.actual: The readers list is empty, so no component is declared to read reviewLog.

findings.claim: The reviewResult format declares only head and verdict and omits detail-json.
findings.intended: A reviewResult requires timestamp, head, verdict, and detail-json.
findings.actual: The declared format contains timestamp, head, and verdict only.

notes: Read 11 allowed files and invoked the one allowed repository command. No files were written or restricted effects attempted; lint assisted all five findings.
